headline.zh: 农业采购供应链风险预警

scenario.zh: 某饮料公司依赖单一地区柑橘供应,需提前识别减产风险并规划替代方案
scenario.en: Beverage company relies on single-region citrus supply, needs early warning of shortfall and backup plan

instruction.zh: 整合哪些信息流以构建早期预警能力
instruction.en: Which data streams to consolidate for early warnings

output.zh: 基础视角已加载,缺少独立验证和外部风险信号
output.en: Basic view loaded, lacks independent verification and external risk signals

output.zh: 多源数据已整合,可交叉验证作物状态并捕捉区域性威胁
output.en: Multi-source data consolidated, enables crop status cross-check and regional threat detection

instruction.zh: 定义何时发出供应链风险警报
instruction.en: Define when to issue supply chain risk alerts

output.zh: 阈值已设定,系统将在减产确认后触发预警
output.en: Threshold set, system alerts after shortfall confirmed

label.zh: 异常气候+病害模式出现

output.zh: 前置指标已激活,可在减产发生前三个月预警
output.en: Leading indicators active, enables three-month advance warning before actual shortfall

title.zh: 对比两个时间窗口预警

instruction.zh: 检查不同预警策略的决策时间差异
instruction.en: Review decision time difference between alert strategies

output.zh: 报告显示干旱模式+柑橘溃疡病早期信号,备选供应商仍有库存
output.en: Report shows drought pattern + early citrus canker signal, backup suppliers still have inventory

output.zh: 报告显示减产已成定局,多数替代供应商已被竞争对手锁定
output.en: Report shows shortfall certain, most alternative suppliers already locked by competitors

instruction.zh: 确认可下载的采购行动建议文档

label.zh: 查看风险量化与时间线

output.zh: 报告展示三个供应商减产概率、影响范围和建议行动窗口
output.en: Report shows three suppliers' shortfall probability, impact scope and recommended action window

output.zh: 报告列出四个备选产区供应商及其当前产能和联系优先级
output.en: Report lists four backup-region suppliers with current capacity and contact priority

takeaway.zh: 整合分散数据源,将供应链反应时间从事后2周提前到风险出现前8周
takeaway.en: Consolidating scattered data extends supply chain reaction time from 2-week post-crisis to 8-week pre-risk

initial.zh: 巴西圣保罗州柑橘采购 | 供应商:3家 | 月需求:800吨 | 合同期:2025Q2-Q4
initial.en: São Paulo citrus sourcing | 3 suppliers | 800t/month | Contract: 2025Q2-Q4
